research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Hannah Life Technologies is engaged in research and development of devices and methods for aiding conception, as described in 'Devices and methods for aiding conception.' The abstract details a conception aid designed for placement in the vaginal canal, featuring capturing elements to collect semen, and outlines a method for using such a device to assist natural conception. Their work focuses on improving accessibility and effectiveness of infertility treatments.

overview_description.description: Hannah Life Technologies is changing the infertility treatment landscape by developing new, groundbreaking and safe fertility products. Alumni of the Stanford Biodesign Fellowship program founded the company to address critical unmet needs in infertility treatment. A Scientific Advisory Board consisting of leading fertility clinicians advise the company.
